prompts.tonariDayPrompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset: Chapter 1 Japanese visual novel 水煙前線, TONARI hookah lounge interior, daytime production background.
Image 1 is the old daytime room, EDIT TARGET and exact architectural/location reference. Image 2 is the existing nighttime room for room continuity only. Image 3 is the adopted title illustration for fine pixel-art/anime texture density only: DO NOT copy character, smoke, equipment or direct charcoal from it. Image 4 is an actual hookah product photograph for physical connection and scale only, not its brand/design or color.
Redraw image 1 at high quality with very fine deliberate pixel clusters, confident crisp architectural edges and subtle anime background material rendering. No blurry upscaling or grain. Output one wide 16:9 image ideally 1920x1080 or greater.
Keep the SAME camera view, floor plan, window panes and all furniture positions: large windows on left, olive-green sofas left and rear, small low dark wood tables, rear single window, right tall built-in wood shelving, right counter and two stools, paper globe ceiling lights, rug. Preserve existing limited greenery because this specific shop has established plants; add NO additional plants, no redesign.
Daylight enters the left windows with coherent warm soft shadows, paper lamps softly warm. Outside is the same modest Japanese city. Warm walnut, olive upholstery and creamy walls, cool daylight highlights; lower quarter and central character area calm enough for VN text and portraits. Clean perspective and modest contrast. No embedded text, no people.
HOOKAH RULES: these unoccupied tables are in preparation BEFORE bowls are mounted. Retain the existing small transparent pear-shaped glass bases and slender SILVER metal stems. Correct stack is glass base -> vertical stem -> flat wide ash tray -> ONE SHORT small protruding metal mounting post centered on the tray. There is NO bowl, NO HMD, NO charcoal, NO foil, NO smoke or flame anywhere: do not misread the bare post as a tall pipe or mini-bowl. The shelf units are stored bare apparatus; no attached hoses.
For the single foreground left table unit: connect exactly ONE thin dark flexible hose to a proper SIDE HOSE PORT on the lower stem just above the glass neck, never to tray/bowl/purge/base-bottom. Hose drapes in a short gravity-consistent arc alongside that table and ends in ONE straight slim rigid dark handle lying on the same tabletop. No Y junction, no third end, no extra cable, no huge looping hose across aisle. Other small rear units can have hoses naturally hidden behind their tables; never create broken free-floating segments. Keep proportions realistic relative to low tables and sofa, tray about palm/hand diameter twice the bowl mounting region; no enlarged glass towers.
Reference photo is for the base-stem-tray-port relationships and hose-vs-handle distinction. Do not copy its brass ornament, logo, labels, colored product finish or BOWL; keep fictional silver hookahs already in the old room.
No readable lettering, labels, watermark or UI. No invented machinery, duplicated furniture, impossible shadows, random pipes, dense fog or glow bloom. Consistent with established anime character sprites.
